# JobQueue.start() method

Starts processing the job queue, refusing to start without a handler.

**Signature:**

```typescript
start(): Promise<JobQueue<T>>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;[JobQueue](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueue/)<!-- -->&lt;T&gt;&gt;

this queue, once the broker connection is up

## Exceptions

TypeError if no handler has been registered with [JobQueue.onPop()](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueue.onpop/) — a combined queue with nothing to consume its own jobs is treated as a mistake rather than started
